Messages.Author: W. Mark Woodhouse
Messages.Body:
You know, GenCon is only a few days away now, and I haven't seen ANY
discussion of the variant tourney LSJ is running: Rapid Thought.
Briefly:

3-person tables
Banned: Minion Tap, Blood Doll, Tribute To The Master
45-minute rounds
40-70 card library

What's up with that? Nobody interested, or is everyone just keeping
their Deck Tech super-extra-secret?

Some folks I've asked about the format locally seem to think it'll be
weenie heaven, but I suspect some other archetypes could work as well.

Here's one idea I had.

Deck Name: Rapid Jack
Created By: WMW
Description: Sheldon intercepts and abuses anything he can, while Jack
lays waste to the table. Generally, you don't want to bring anybody
but Sheldon and maybe Nikolaus out... might even go to 6 Sheldon (drop
Luma & Sabine).

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 19, Max: 36, Avg: 6.75)
----------------------------------------------
4 Sheldon ANI AUS for OBF POT 9, Nosferatu, Justicar
2 Nikolaus Vermeulen ani for obf POT 7, Nosferatu, Prince
1 Zack North ani for pot pro 6, Gangrel
1 Badger ani FOR pot PRO 6, Gangrel
1 Luma aus FOR pot vis 5, Gargoyle
1 Sabine Lafitte aus dom pot tha 5, Tremere
1 Calebros ANI obf pot 5, Nosferatu, Prince
1 Sammy ani obf pot 4, Nosferatu

Library: (69 cards)
-------------------
Master (10 cards)
1 Barrens, The
1 Golconda: Inner Peace (emergency pool gain)
1 Millicent Smith, Puritan Vampire Hunter
1 Powerbase: Chicago
1 Protected Resources
1 Rumor Mill, Tabloid Newspaper, The
4 Smiling Jack, The Anarch

Action (6 cards)
2 Fourth Tradition: The Accounting, The (pool gain)
2 Judgment: Camarilla Segregation
2 Restoration

Reaction (18 cards)
6 Cats' Guidance
4 Eagle's Sight (stop ousts)
8 Second Tradition: Domain, The (protect Jack)

Combat (31 cards)
2 Fists of Death
6 Immortal Grapple
3 Increased Strength
4 Skin of Rock
4 Taste of Vitae
6 Torn Signpost
6 Undead Strength

Retainer (2 cards)
2 Raven Spy

Equipment (2 cards)
2 Sport Bike
